Name: Rasmodius Refined - A Wizard Sprite Overhaul
Author: turtiny
Description:
I made this for myself but I thought I'd share!

There's four versions:
[b]Vanilla XNB[/b]: Regular old XNB you put in the contents > characters folder in your Stardew.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceble Rasmodius[/url]: Overwrites NewWizard in assets > sprites. Config accordingly.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]: Overwrites Magnus in assets > CharacterFiles > OverworldSprites > Magnus folder. Make sure you have any other sprite mods (seasonal or otherwise) disabled.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodius SVE Compatible[/url]: Same as Romanceable Rasmodius. Overwrites NewWizard in assets > sprites. Config accordingly.

There's two versions for each, one [b]with[/b] a cape and one [b]without[/b]. Only pick one!

Custom Flower Dance and Wedding attire included. Play and find out!
I haven't tested extensively, so let me know if it breaks horribly.
Enjoy!
